Typecheck root cause confirmed: tsconfig.json omitted generated dist/** from exclude, allowing astro check to analyze production minified bundles; normal and 6 GB baseline runs exhausted Node before a repository assertion result.

Fix: added dist/** to tsconfig.json exclude and a check-project-invariants.mjs contract. npm run check:invariants passes 56 contracts; npm run typecheck completes with 0 errors and 12 pre-existing hints.
Post-fix canonical npm run check:fast passed: invariants, lint, authored-source typecheck, and 183 test files / 3,041 passing tests completed without a heap exhaustion.

Wave 2 reproduced a safe-to-fix browser-state defect: tools-reminders.js accepted parseable non-object localStorage (for example true), then threw on checkbox change in strict mode. The focused red test failed with Cannot create property on boolean; object-shape validation made the same test pass.

The same malformed-state class independently reproduced in src/features/reminders/gateway.js: boolean true became the mutable local item map and gateway.add threw. A focused red/green regression now proves object-shape validation before local fallback mutation.

A third independent case was reproduced in route-opt persistence: boolean true became the saved route-order record and Apply threw while writing a day key. The focused route-opt red/green regression proves the same object-shape boundary at this distinct owner.

A fourth independent case was reproduced in per-tab scroll memory: boolean true became the saved tab-position map and the scroll callback threw while writing itinerary. The focused scroll-memory red/green regression proves object-shape validation at this distinct owner.

guide-ui journey-station persistence had the same parse-and-mutate structure: a stored primitive could become seen before markSeen assigned a key. It now uses the shared parseStoredRecord contract, whose records-only behavior is unit-proven; typecheck passed after integration.

field-tools stop check-off had the same parse-and-mutate structure: a stored primitive could become stopState before a traveler toggle assigned a key. It now uses parseStoredRecord; the shared records-only contract and typecheck are green after integration.

Wave 2 rescan classified remaining browser-storage readers: Trip Split and panel models validate shape before mutable use; live weather/rate caches are validator- or freshness-gated and fail soft; Atlas restore is read-only; malformed Firebase room fragments already fail closed. No additional independently owned high-confidence invalid-state candidate remained.
